content.title: Usher and Chris Brown set presale for joint 2026 tour
content.text: Presale timing and ticket expectations Chris Brown and Usher’s Raymond & Brown Tour will open presales around April 16, 2026, via Ticketmaster and Live Nation. While official prices are not yet confirmed, early estimates suggest premium seats may range from $275 to $350. Given both artists’ individual drawing power, industry watchers expect swift sellouts once tickets go live. Men's Journal + 1 A high-profile R&B partnership Running from April 1 to May 24, 2026, the Raymond & Brown Tour marks the first joint headlining stadium trek for Usher and Chris Brown. The name plays on their surnames and the R&B genre, signaling a celebration of their combined legacies. This collaboration comes after years of mutual respect despite past rumors of tension, and even a reported 2023 altercation, making the pairing notable for fans and the industry. EURweb + 2 Social media fuels anticipation The tour announcement dropped via a cinematic Instagram teaser showing the artists riding motorcycles through city streets, chased by fans, before stepping onto a stadium stage. Reactions across platforms have been explosive, with comparisons to Jay-Z and Kanye West’s Watch The Throne tour and predictions that it will break records. Some fans joked about financial sacrifices to attend, underscoring the intense demand. The Root + 3 From teaser to tour timeline The joint tour was announced April 10, 2026, with both artists posting the same high-energy video on Instagram. While the full city list and dates are pending, the nearly two-month stadium run is set for major U.S. markets, with possible global legs hinted at by insiders. The announcement builds on past collaborations like “New Flame” and “It Depends (The Remix),” and is expected to blend solo hits with joint performances.
